**What changes, and why:**

- [ ] `make check` and `make lint` pass
- [ ] tests for the change, where the code can be tested without root
- [ ] the docs say it (`docs/USING.md` for projects, `docs/ADMIN.md` for admins)
- [ ] a line under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] tried on a box (say how), if it touches the box
